correctness.rationale: The bijection from size n-1 crown matchings to derangements on n+1 symbols, with 0 encoding the two holes, identifies exactly the two legal transposition families and gives all-order D_(n+1) vertices, degree sequence, sign imbalance and non-Hamiltonicity. A new independent derangement-graph program enumerated all states and neighbors for n=3,...,8; BFS from one representative of each stabilizer-conjugacy orbit reproduces sizes 9,44,265,1854,14833,133496, all stated edge/center/diameter statistics and at n=8 radius10, diameter11, center14832, 2593920 diametral pairs. Symmetry reduction makes these finite claims exhaustive; no n>=9 distance theorem follows.
